channel.title: Trenchward Product Feed
channel.description: Compact machinery. Direct pricing. Real support.

item.g:title: TYPHON TERROR XIX STORM -- 1.8-Ton Kubota Diesel Mini Excavator
item.g:description: The Terror XIX Storm is a 1.8-ton mini excavator powered by a Kubota D902 diesel. A swing boom lets you work flush against structures; the rubber track undercarriage won't destroy driveways. Trailerable behind a standard pickup. Free freight, factory-crated.

item.g:title: TYPHON STOMP -- 22.1 HP Honda Tracked Skid Steer Loader
item.g:description: The STOMP is a 1,830 lb tracked skid steer loader with a 22.1 HP Honda V-twin. Three hydraulic valves make it attachment-ready out of the box. Compact enough for tight spaces, with the power to move serious material.

item.g:title: RIPPA R32 PRO -- 3.2-Ton Kubota V1505 Mini Excavator
item.g:description: The R32 PRO is a 3.2-ton mini excavator with a Kubota V1505 four-cylinder diesel — 25 HP with 2,827 mm digging depth. Enclosed cab, steel undercarriage, full attachment compatibility. Ships freight-crated.

item.g:title: TYPHON NAGA 4.0 -- 4-Ton Yanmar Diesel, Zero Tail Swing
item.g:description: The NAGA 4.0 is a 4-ton class zero-tail-swing mini excavator powered by a Yanmar Tier 4 Final diesel. AC cabin, 7-inch touchscreen, LED work lights, and full attachment hydraulics. The most capable machine in the lineup.

item.g:title: SG24 Stump Grinder -- 24-Inch 3-Point PTO Stump Grinder for 15–45 HP Tractors
item.g:description: The SG24 mounts to any 15–45 HP tractor with a standard Cat. 1 three-point hitch. 34 carbide teeth on a 24-inch flywheel grind stumps 6 inches below grade. PTO shaft included, free freight.

item.g:title: B200 Wood Chipper -- 35 HP Towable Drum Wood Chipper — 8-Inch Capacity
item.g:description: The B200 is a 35 HP towable drum chipper handling branches up to 8 inches in diameter. Hydraulic self-feeding rollers bring material in automatically. Reversible alloy-steel knives extend blade life. Free freight.

item.g:title: SGR1500 Stump Grinder -- 15 HP Gasoline Self-Propelled Stump Grinder
item.g:description: The SGR1500 is a standalone 15 HP gas stump grinder — no tractor needed. A DUCAR 420cc EPA/CARB-certified engine drives a 12-inch cutting wheel 10 inches below grade. Self-propelled, towable, 265 lb net weight.
